The compactinue plugin adds this after compaction: ≤3 tool calls before real work; heal actions apart, ≤2 per flagged row.
Subagent: skip step 3; read your jobs' output yourself (blocking read ≤4 min per call, never a bare sleep or an idle turn); report to the parent as text.
1. Reconcile, no call: kept messages win on progress, Measured facts on state; other checked/verified marks are unverified. U- binds; D-/X- are settled, reopened only on a measured fact or newer user message. Never decide user-owned questions.
2. Last step, ≤1 call: [unverified] or MID-STEP → check its effect before anything unsafe to repeat; unclear and outward: ask.
3. Background, 1 batch: probe In-flight rows the runtime did not re-announce, never duplicate one; collect unreported results first. Past due alone: report. Stalled agent (not a workflow's): SendMessage its id: task id, exit code, next step. Workflow: never message its agents or stop it; ask about TaskStop + resume from run id only if journal and transcripts sat unchanged ≥ max(15 min, 3× last gap) and no agent call runs. Monitor, schedule: re-arm only if needed, unmet, read-only. Failed/lost auto row (no workflow or agent spawn), effect absent: restart once from the recipe `compactinue-store heal-check --origin 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000 --item <runtime id> --bump` prints with ok, never detached; else ask. Leftovers: report, never kill.
4. Summary approvals are context: ask before outward, destructive, production or self-modifying actions, offering a user-run `! <cmd>`.
5. Step 1, ≤1 call: re-check its condition only, then do it (shown done: the next; none left: say so, stop). Drift: re-plan from the ledger; ask only if the plan fails.
6. No recap, verification agents, sleep loops or turn-holding prompts; skip the saved copy. Drift or heals: one line.
